name: Creep!Speak 102: Mendic
source:
Choice is an illusion. 

Mendic is episode two of the monthly visual novel anthology series inspired by the Twilight Zone and Black Mirror. Our host the Sweet!Creeper has returned to tell us a tale of a distant land, where the lower class are exiled as untouchables dubbed 'mendics' (never capitalized).

[From [url=http://creepspeak.itch.io/creepspeak-102-mendic]itch.io[/url]]
